source: Keyboard desk research, 2026-11-25: five researchers proposed ideas, one sceptic per area scored them. Opinions, not measurements. Four of the five sceptics could not search the web.

fields.lens: research area: sensing (Switch and sensing), input_feedback (Extra input and feedback), smarts (MCU, connectivity and software), ergo_form (Ergonomics and form), as_code (Designed-as-code)
fields.name: the idea as the researcher named it
fields.label: short name used in the figures and docs
fields.score: the sceptic's 1-10 score for worth building
fields.verdict: the sceptic's verdict: keep, keep_as_moonshot, demote, drop
fields.novelty: the sceptic's rating: table_stakes, common, niche_exists, rare
fields.feasibility: the sceptic's rating on this toolchain: straightforward, hard, research_needed, impractical
fields.daily_driver_value: the sceptic's rating: high, medium, low, gimmick
fields.status: the owner's choice on 2026-11-25: picked (one of the 12 features in concept.md), folded (supporting work folded into a picked feature), not picked
fields.section: concept.md section of the picked feature, or of the feature a folded idea is part of
